qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate d0d6d08 and serialized rechecks of the signed fix commits b00e465 and a1fe63a found no remaining defect. Correctness raised four minor findings. カード attributed the Japanese dough-scraper sense to the Russian noun «карточка»; the body now says that some Japanese baking texts use カード for a dough scraper (JMdict 1036400 sense 7). カード also restricted Russian «карта» to payment and playing cards with «только»; the 地図 map contrast stays, and the translation is now chosen by context. Three titles narrowed their source headword: ダイヤ is now «алмаз; бриллиант; график движения поездов» («бриллиант» requires a cut stone; Gramota бриллиант), スター «звезда; знаменитость» (the body teaches the symbol and celestial senses) and スタンド «трибуна; подставка, стойка; настольная или напольная лампа» (JMdict 1069930 sense 4). ソファー's substantive ベンチ comparison now links the existing card. Consistency raised four minor quiz-safety under-guards, all accepted: トラック–自動車 (the バス and タクシー precedent), デート–日付 (the taught calendar-date sense), スタンド–ガソリンスタンド (the taught petrol-station use) and スタンド–明かり (the lamp sense), plus the same ベンチ link. Comprehensibility raised two minor findings. カード's «сырный сгусток» could read as a cheese clot; the curd sense is now «молочный сгусток», the cheesemaking term, defined as the curdled milk mass cheese is made from. ジュース's bare «ровно» read as an adverb rather than a score; fix 1 used «равный счёт», and the correctness recheck found that this also covers 15:15 or 30:30, which are not deuce (R1). Fix 2 titles the sense «счёт «ровно» (в теннисе и др.)» and defines it as the tie one point short of winning a game or set, decided by two consecutive points, in tennis 40:40 and later ties in the same game (Digital Daijisen and Seisen Nihon Kokugo Daijiten on Kotobank, both multi-sport); its example says «счёт стал «ровно» (40:40)». Two optional items were adopted: スープ's verb note «по-русски обычно говорят «есть суп»» and トラック's «ехать на грузовике». All three reviewers read all 30 cards in full against EN. Russian evidence includes Gramota entries (карточка, открытка, демонстрация, команда, шанс, танец, диван, центр, набор, установка, настройка, звезда, трибуна, стиль, фигура, выключатель, переключатель, группа, бонус, карта, бриллиант, лампа, надежда, шатёр, свежий), Russian Wiktionary (сгусток, карта, деним) and specialist tennis, cheesemaking and speed-skating sources. The rechecks found no regression. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 18 EN exclusions across 13 lists are retained, including the in-batch トランプ–カード. Twenty-five direct, one-sided exclusions on 18 new cards (eight of them new lists) cover reviewed RU title overlaps and sense neighbours. Required (18), as the consistency reviewer classified them: カード–地図 (the Russian homograph «карта»), トラック–車, チーム–命令 («команда»), チャンス–望み («шанс»), ダンス–踊り («танец»), ダイヤ–宝石 and ダイヤ–玉 (the gem sense), ダイヤ–予定 (the timetable), スター–有名, スタンド–電灯 («лампа»), ジーンズ–ズボン, ジュース–飲み物 («напиток»), ジェット機–飛行機 («самолёт»), ゲーム–遊び («игра»), グループ–クラス («группа»), グランド–大きい and グランド–大きな («большой»), and, added in the fix, スタンド–ガソリンスタンド. Conservative to required (1), added in the fix: トラック–自動車. Conservative (6): タイプライター–機械, センター–選手, スタンド–受付 and サービス–無料, and, added in the fix, デート–日付 and スタンド–明かり. The author had classed only チャンス–望み, ダンス–踊り, ジェット機–飛行機, ゲーム–遊び, グランド–大きい and グランド–大きな as required; the records preserve both classifications. The candidate declared the first 21. Fix 1 also added ジュース–等しい for its standalone «равный»; fix 2 removed that label and withdrew the guard. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

One source exclusion edge lies inside the batch (トランプ–カード); the other 17 EN exclusion entries target existing RU cards.

Links otherwise follow EN, with eight RU-only links to existing cards at a substantive comparison or mention: カード→地図, チャンス→望み, ダンス→踊り, ソファー→いす (link text 椅子), ソファー→ベンチ, スタンド→ガソリンスタンド, スタンド→台 and ジーンズ→履く. キャンプ is planned for Batch 62; its link from テント is held for that batch.

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined optional items: «поздравительную открытку» for カード's greeting card (correctness; «поздравительная карточка» is ordinary Russian and keeps the title word), «(в бейсболе)» on センター's player gloss (correctness; the body and example state the baseball context), グランド's comma title (comprehensibility; not a wrong gloss, and the body explains the compound use), the 灯 lamp pair for スタンド and トラック–乗り物 (consistency; neither needed, and the reviewer withdrew both). The correctness reviewer's numerical deuce clarification was adopted in ジュース's body and example through R1, not in the title. The comprehensibility reviewer's «(для сыра)» was not adopted, to keep «сыр» out of カード's title next to チーズ «сыр». The consistency recheck noted that ジュース's «счёт» shares a word with 会計 and 勘定, as on the candidate; the sense qualifier differs, and it required no change. No reviewer finding remains open.
